//: Every setting that decides a render's pixels. render_solid.py applies these explicitly (env vars may override per job); run.ts hashes this file and the running Blender's version into every output's name, and refuses a different Blender version. The cycles block equals Blender 4.5.14's factory defaults, read from Blender (not guessed), so renders made before this file existed are unchanged.

device.//: auto tries OPTIX, CUDA, METAL, HIP, ONEAPI in order, then CPU. RENDER_DEVICE=<name> forces one and fails if it is missing. Not in the hash: devices differ only in noise, not in what is drawn.

passes.//: Grey levels the two surface-pass renders use (pack-passes.ts GREYS).
